reviews.x: So happy with my order it’s more then I accept 🤩😻🥳😍

reviews.t: Sharp Cuticle Pushing Tool Gouges Nails
reviews.x: This product had many great reviews at the time of ordering in April 2021.  I put some cuticle eliminator on, waited the 45 seconds, and went to work on pushing back my cuticles.  I've used a bamboo pusher before and might switch back to those if I can't get the angle of this sharp product just right.  Both ends are sharp.  They did not sand the rounded edge as I would expect.  When I went to push the cuticle back it repeatedly gouged into my natural nails causing ridges.  I haven't done this in

reviews.t: Can’t beat the quality for the price
reviews.x: Sally’s beauty was charging $11 just for a cuticle nipper.... I searched on Amazon and thought I’d give it a try. The quality is incredible and you get nippers, a double sided cuticle scraper, and a file for like $4. Definitely recommend

I started doing my nails at home and needed a cuticle trimmer. I didn't want to spend too much money and was worried this product wouldn't work well - however, the trimmers are super sharp and the cuticle pusher works great! Just make sure you're precise, because I've cut myself a few times. I haven't used the opposite end of the cuticle pusher, which I'm assuming is for if you're stamping large nail polish designs and want to cut it to fit the nail.

I was excited to use this product but was extremely disappointed after I'd waited for one of the two items that I ordered. There is NO cuticle pusher although that's what the packing and product name states. Absolutely ridiculous.

reviews.t: WAY TOO SHARP! Not in a good way!
reviews.x: Normally having an item that’s mean to cut things that’s really sharp would be a good thing. But these are way too sharp. I tried to cut off the smallest little hang nail on my right hand (I’m right handed) & I barely even touched my skin & it sliced into the side of my finger. It’s like.. impossible just to clip off the skin you want to clip. There’s too dull & too sharp. There’s a perfect in between that isn’t dangerous. These are wayyyyyy too sharp. You’re going to end up taking off too much

reviews.t: The cuticle clippers are very sharp!
reviews.x: I can say that the cuticle clippers are very sharp!, be careful!, I'm still learning how to use these clippers and seem to always bring blood. The cuticle pusher does well on pushing your cuticles back but the opposite end of it that has a little blade for cutting the cuticle is not sharp at all. Overall I would still recommend these for just the cuticle clippers alone as they do a good job. There is not much more that I can say about this item other than it comes in a little plastic pouch.

I bought this and didn't realize how sharp it was. I was using it and dropped something I quickly tried to grab I and before I knew it I cut the finger on my opposite hand so badly it needed stitches it barly grased my finger and it literally cut my finger so badly it was a mess. From the top of my ring finger near nail just about to the first bending line. So I'd be careful buying or using these on young teens or people who aren't vigilant.  Be careful!

i love these for the money i paid. they are gorgeous. i haven't used these yet but i did eximine them. yes, they are soooo sharp, at least mine were by me touching them. the seller did a great job sending these out. i got these because my computer gives me the option to move my mouse around to see a bigger view and liked what i saw on the sharpness of these. i hope the other buyers that got a bad product either get a replacement or their money back

reviews.t: Works really well, good quality, but very sharp
reviews.x: These are my first cuticle pusher and clipper. So I'm not experienced at all. They work really well. I used the Blue Cross Cuticle remover liquid, kept it on for a few minutes, and used the pusher to scrap off the cuticle. Worked like a charm. The clippers are very sharp and good for accurate clipping of excess skin and remaining stubborn cuticle. I did bleed from two fingers the first time, but I was more careful the next, and it was perfect.

Literally the best cuticle pusher and nipper I have ever used! The cuticle pusher is the best, If you can’t afford a drill then this will be your best friend! The nippers are sharp enough to remove overgrown cuticles with out leaving any rough edges and so sturdy! I’m amazed at the quality for the price. Buying more to give out as gifts.

It’s a great product, the pressure is perfect when you open and close, but it’s extremely sharp!!! So I only recommend for someone who is comfortable with doing their nails often, but if you’re starting out then be extremely careful not to get a cut, wouldn’t use on kids because they move too much etc. but it cuts fast and well!!

reviews.t: After this experience...now I can die
reviews.x: For years was a nightmare cut the nails of my big toes, today was a great pleasure!...it’s so sharp so be careful, cut your toes in the surgery way.  I Appreciate this and thanks for this product it’s just amazing! I definitely recommend it. By the way, don’t need to put too much pressure when you are cutting your toes.

reviews.t: Super sharp and easy to use
reviews.x: It is very sharp. Snips right through soaked calluses. I absolutely love this. I give my boyfriend pedicures and manicures because he has really bad feet and nails because of years for neglect and stress, but with this it cuts so much time off of this ordeal and it makes his feet look those they are new.

reviews.t: It’s very sharp!! Easy to use.
reviews.x: It’s pretty sharp which I like 👍🏽 it’s light weight and easy to use.  I use it to push back my cuticles, scrape dead skin and cut the extra dead cuticle off of my fingers. I also use this for my daughter since she bites her nails and skin Surrounding her finger nail. It’s honestly perfect 👍🏽 for us!!

These are nice and sharp, and fit in the hand with a decent tension. However the nippers tips or cutting blades are of a soft metal. So they bend out of shape easily. So if you happen to drop these from more than a 4inch height, they will likely end up wonky or bent. So they are good for u9e use,

Really a great set for the price.  It is sharp and you should soak your hands first as a softer cuticle will give you better results.  I didn't do that the first time as I was anxious to use it with not as good results as when I was more relaxed about it with a nice soak in a soapy solution.

These are far better than the professional nippers I had been using. These are a fraction of the price. No complaints. However they are super sharp so I am a bit more cautious.  I haven't had them long enough to see how they hold up in barbacide or my uv disinfectant oven. I have 3 sets now.

reviews.t: Nippers work good but cuticle pusher isn’t round
reviews.x: The cuticle nippers work good; they’re nice and sharp and do the job well, just be careful not to cut yourself. The pusher however isn’t that round. It does the job but is a little uncomfortable on the nail. It will push the cuticle back but it’s more of a flat head as opposed to a round one

I purchased one of these a few months ago and they worked great - nippers were sharp and provided a clean cut.  Unfortunately I lost those and repurchased the same item expecting the same quality.  Sadly, the product that arrived is not as sharp and doesn't provide the same experience.

The cuticle pusher damaged my nail. I suppose it could be user error, but I did it as normal as created an indention in my nail that has still not grown out months later. The trimmer is so sharp it’s concerning. It could really hurt you, but it definitely works!

Update... the clippers broke. Had a previous pair of clippers for 20 years. Companies make only throw away junk anymore. Would never buy again!  I love these! They are sharp, get the job done and make my nails look great. I would buy these again any day.

reviews.t: These thing are awesome for a LICENSED NAIL TECH!
reviews.x: So these are amazing! Buy buyer beware....I am licensed nail tech/ cosmetologist. And these babys are SHARP! They are cut like so smooth you won't even know your cut until seconds later!!! But....they are awesome if you know what your doing!

This trimmer is extremely sharp, which is exactly what you want in a cuticle trimmer. Invariably, you will get a hanging too cold on your dominant hand. Then you have to use your nondominant hand to trim it. These make quick work of that.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the tools as very sharp and effective for cutting cuticles and nails.
Several reviewers warn that the tools are dangerously sharp and have caused cuts or injuries.
Reviewers frequently highlight good quality and value for the price.
Some reviewers report missing items or packaging problems.
A few reviewers note the cuticle pusher works well.
